item.title: DUENCH: Greyhounds find belief in defeat — now they get to prove it down the stretch
item.description: A short-staffed stand against the league-leading Brantford Bulldogs offered belief amid a three-loss weekend — but results against the best remain the test.

item.title: Sault police not participating in federal gun buyback program
item.description: Sault police join several Ontario services in opting out of the program, citing resource constraints, while still accepting voluntary firearm surrenders.

item.title: Hockey president condemns parent behaviour at Soo Pee Wee tournament
item.description: Referee claims he was threatened with violent gesture during weekend tournament; NOHA vows swift action against abusive parent behaviour.

item.title: Algoma Public Health to issue suspension notices
item.description: Unit requires up-to-date immunization record, valid exemption

item.title: Sault fire crews contain residential garage blaze
item.description: Detached garage heavily damaged by flames; fire crews contain blaze, no injuries reported.

item.title: Top honours
item.description: Morley Torgov received his medal in Toronto in January.

item.title: Community Builders Construction gets grant from Sault city council
item.description: Community Builders Construction is expected to generate between 10-20 full-time equivalent positions, provide skilled trades training and help create affordable housing.
